name: Local Business Schema Generator by StackDev
author: wpstackdev

sections.description:
Local Business Schema Generator by StackDev is a lightweight WordPress plugin that generates valid JSON-LD LocalBusiness schema markup for your website. It helps local businesses improve local SEO, Google rich results, and search visibility—without installing heavy SEO plugins.

Why Use This Local Business Schema Generator?

  • Simple & Lightweight: No bloat, no unnecessary features
  • Google-Friendly: Outputs clean, valid Schema.org markup
  • Conflict-Aware: Detects duplicate schema from SEO plugins
  • Beginner-Friendly: Plain English labels, no technical knowledge needed

Perfect For

  • Plumbers, Electricians, Contractors
  • Hair Salons, Spas, Beauty Clinics
  • Dental Offices, Medical Practices
  • Restaurants, Cafes, Food Services
  • Retail Stores, Local Shops
  • Service Area Businesses

Key Features

  • Business name, address, phone (NAP) data
  • Business type selection (LocalBusiness subtypes)
  • Logo upload/URL field
  • Opening hours specification
  • Geo coordinates (latitude/longitude)
  • Live schema preview in admin
  • Schema validation checking
  • Conflict detection with Yoast/Rank Math
  • Clean JSON-LD output in <head>

No Coding Required

Simply fill out the intuitive settings page, and the plugin automatically generates and inserts the proper structured data. Your business information will be properly recognized by Google, Bing, and other search engines.

Arbitrary section

Support

For support, please use the WordPress support forums.

Contributing

Found a bug? Have a feature request? Please submit issues or pull requests on GitHub.

Privacy

This plugin does not collect any user data. All information entered is stored only in your WordPress database and used solely for generating structured data output.
sections.installation:
1. Upload stackdev-local-business-schema folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings → Business Schema
  4. Fill in your business information
  5. Enable schema and save
sections.faq:
What is Schema.org markup?

Schema.org is a collaborative, community activity with a mission to create, maintain, and promote schemas for structured data on the Internet. This plugin outputs LocalBusiness schema in JSON-LD format.

Will this conflict with my SEO plugin?

The plugin detects if Yoast SEO or Rank Math is outputting LocalBusiness schema and shows a warning. You can disable their local business schema to avoid duplicates.

How do I validate my schema?

After saving your settings, use Google’s Rich Results Test to validate your structured data.

Does this work with Google Business Profile?

This plugin outputs the structured data Google needs to understand your business. Connect it with your Google Business Profile for best results.

Can I add multiple locations?

The free version supports one location. Multiple locations are available in the PRO version.

What business types are supported?

All Schema.org LocalBusiness subtypes including:
* LocalBusiness (General)
* HomeAndConstructionBusiness
* HealthAndBeautyBusiness
* ProfessionalService
* FoodEstablishment
* Store
* And more…
